content: तरल {%a.%} [तॄ-अलच्] .²1 Trembling, waving, shaking, tremulous; तारापतिस्तरलविद्युदिवाभ्रवृन्दम् <ls>R. 13. 76</ls>; घन इव तरलबलाके <ls>Gīt. 5</ls>; <ls>Śi. 10. 40</ls>; <ls>U. 5. 11</ls>; <ls>Ś. 1. 25</ls>. .²2 Fickle, unsteady, transient; वैरायितारस्तरलाः स्वयं मत्सरिणः परम् <ls>Śi. 2. 115</ls>; <ls>Amaru. 30</ls>. .²3 Splendid, sparkling, glittering; तारावितानतरला इव यामवत्यः <ls>Ki. 8. 56</ls>. .²4 Liquid. .²5 Libidinous, wanton. .²6 Hollow. .²7 Extensive, wide. .{@-लः@} .²1 The central gem of a necklace; मुक्तामयोऽप्यतरलमध्यः <ls>Vās. 35</ls>; or हारांस्तारांस्तरलगुटिकान् (<ls>Malli.</ls> considers this as an interpolation in Meghadūta). .²2 A necklace. .²3 A level surface. .²4 Bottom, depth. .²5 A diamond. .²6 Iron. .²7 Thorn-apple. .{@-ला@} .²1 Rice-gruel. .²2 Spirituous liquor. .²3 A bee.
